import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pandas.arrays import SparseArray

# Example 1: M8[ns] with a NaT gap and fill_value=np.nan
try:
    vals1 = np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype="i8").astype("M8[ns]")
    vals1[1] = "NaT"
    arr1 = SparseArray(vals1, fill_value=np.nan)
    e1_dtype = float(arr1.to_dense().dtype == np.dtype(object))
    e1_i8 = float(np.array_equal(np.asarray(arr1, dtype="i8"), np.asarray(vals1, dtype="i8")))
except Exception:
    e1_dtype = float("nan")
    e1_i8 = float("nan")
probe("ex1_dense_is_object", e1_dtype)
probe("ex1_i8_eq_dense_i8", e1_i8)

# Example 2: M8[s] with a fill_value boxed in ns (fill in another unit)
try:
    vals2 = np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype="i8").astype("M8[s]")
    fill2 = pd.Timestamp(vals2[1]).as_unit("ns")
    arr2 = SparseArray(vals2, fill_value=fill2)
    e2_dtype = float(arr2.to_dense().dtype == np.dtype(object))
    e2_i8 = float(np.array_equal(np.asarray(arr2, dtype="i8"), np.asarray(vals2, dtype="i8")))
except Exception:
    e2_dtype = float("nan")
    e2_i8 = float("nan")
probe("ex2_dense_is_object", e2_dtype)
probe("ex2_i8_eq_dense_i8", e2_i8)

# Example 3: take() with a string fill on timedelta64[s]
try:
    vals3 = np.array([1, 3, 5], dtype="m8[s]")
    arr3 = SparseArray(vals3)
    res3 = arr3.take(np.array([0, -1]), allow_fill=True, fill_value="1 days")
    e3_ok = 1.0
    e3_0 = float(np.asarray(res3.to_dense(), dtype="i8")[0])
    e3_1 = float(np.asarray(res3.to_dense(), dtype="i8")[1])
except Exception:
    e3_ok = 0.0
    e3_0 = float("nan")
    e3_1 = float("nan")
probe("ex3_m8_string_fill_ok", e3_ok)
probe("ex3_m8_take_0", e3_0)
probe("ex3_m8_take_1", e3_1)

# Example 3b: take() with a string fill on datetime64[s]
try:
    vals3b = np.array([1, 3, 5], dtype="M8[s]")
    arr3b = SparseArray(vals3b)
    res3b = arr3b.take(np.array([0, -1]), allow_fill=True, fill_value="1970-01-02")
    e3b_ok = 1.0
    e3b_1 = float(np.asarray(res3b.to_dense(), dtype="i8")[1])
except Exception:
    e3b_ok = 0.0
    e3b_1 = float("nan")
probe("ex3_M8_string_fill_ok", e3b_ok)
probe("ex3_M8_take_1", e3b_1)
